sources.label: Patches for the Wykop.pl app, for use with Morphe
sources.author: HagiaHaya
patch_list: Add deals to calendar
Adds "Add to calendar" to the menu of a deal, which creates an event when the deal starts, or before it expires.
Block tracking

Blocks the analytics of Pepper, such as reports of the deals visited and shared and tracking pixels, Firebase Analytics, Facebook app events, Adjust, Iterable and the start of the SDKs of ads. Adds a setting to send a random device ID inst…
Catch Flamedeer

Adds a setting to get a notification when a Flamedeer ("Ognisty Renifer") of the Flamedeer hunt shows up, or to catch it at once by opening its prize screen. Flamedeers found while the app is in the background get a notification instead of…
Enable debug menu
Adds a setting to show the hidden debug menu of the developers of Pepper at the top right of the home screen. Some of its actions can break the app.
Filter comments
Adds a setting to hide comments, and the replies to them, that contain certain words.
Filter deals
Adds settings to hide deals and discussions from all lists by keyword, store, member, category, highest price or lowest temperature.
GmsCore support
Allows signing in with Google and receiving notifications by using MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services.
Price error alerts
Adds a setting to get a notification of new deals with a discount of at least 70 to 95%, such as price errors. Checks every 10 minutes, also in the background.
Remove ads
Removes the ads shown between deals and on the deal pages.
Sanitize deal links
Opens the store page of a deal directly, instead of through redirects that track the click and add affiliate links.
Sanitize sharing links
Shares the direct link to deals and discussions, instead of a link that redirects through a tracking service.
Search comments
Adds "Search comments" to the menu of a deal, which loads all its comments and replies, and finds the ones with the words entered.
Show price with shipping
Adds a setting to show the price with shipping next to the shipping costs of deals, such as "+ 9,99zł = 59,98zł".
Spoof contributor level

Adds a setting to show Silver, Gold or Platinum in the app, such as on the profile, instead of the contributor level earned. It unlocks the app icons of the level, but rewards granted by Pepper, such as more deal stats, are not unlocked.
Unlock custom app icons
Unlocks all app icons regardless of the contributor level, and offers the seasonal icons, such as the Black Friday one, all year round.
